name: Niimi Masamune
source:
A former gang member who got turned into a police cyborg.

After being falsely accused and serving some time in prison, he accepted the cyborg surgery and entered into a transactional relationship with the police to get his revenge.

Though now a police cyborg, he still lives by the Yakuza code of honour

Part of Tenkai District Special Police

[Modified from [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3595800/ROAD59_A_Yakuzas_Last_Stand/]Steam page[/url]]
